heroSubtitle: BARKLEY FC - Sports training academy committed with the integral development of children and youth. Categories from 5 to 18 years old in Cali, Valle del Cauca. Roots in Barbacoas, Nariño.
missionText: Training children and youth through football, developing their physical, technical, tactical and cognitive capabilities, within an educational environment based on values such as respect, discipline, responsibility and teamwork.
visionText: By 2030, BARKLEY FC will be recognized as a leading football training academy in the city of Cali and the department of Valle del Cauca, standing out for the quality of its training processes, its training methodology and the projection of talents towards competitive and professional football.
value1: Discipline - Base of sports and personal growth
value2: Respect - Towards teammates, coaches and rivals
value3: Responsibility - Commitment to the training process
value4: Teamwork - Understanding football as a collective game
value5: Commitment - Total delivery in every training
value6: Perseverance - Overcoming obstacles and constantly improving
value7: Honesty - Acting with integrity inside and outside the field
methodologyItems: Long Term Development - LTAD model of the athlete
Integral Training - Technical, tactical, physical and psychological
Game-Based Learning - Active and fun methodology
Age Adaptation - According to the development stage
Continuous Progress - Constant and measurable evolution
